title: Mental images connections (A2)
description: Sort 16 easy words about pictures in your mind into four groups.

groups.name: Things your mind does
groups.explanation: Verbs for what happens in your head.

groups.name: Parts of the body
groups.explanation: Parts of your body that help you see and think.

groups.name: Describing a mental picture
groups.explanation: Words to say how your picture looks.

groups.name: Things you can look at
groups.explanation: Things made of images that you can see on a screen or paper.
